title: Fundamental: Platform-Native Relational Field Runtime
description: Fundamental (v0.11.0) is a platform-native relational field runtime where visual and interactive elements dynamically bend a physical field, and the field in turn continuously governs their motion and boundaries. Designed for multi-target, deterministic simulation across TypeScript/DOM, Rust, Swift (FieldLabKit), and Kotlin/Android, it features cross-language golden conformance vectors, continuous interaction physics, and empirical abstraction evaluation.
notes: Accompanying research software for continuous interaction fields and empirical computation theories.
